semantic_findings: The pointwise finite union bound includes faults outside the sampling universe correctly. At the repaired rate 1/(2f), all f>0 cases including f=1 give at least one-half probability of avoiding the at-most-f original faults.

The literal sampled graph retains the deterministic host and clips sampled edges to current non-seed edges. A fault-disjoint host and sample embed into the actual post-fault current graph, so an actual failed fault-cover witness implies the true failure probability lower bound.

The finite tape and estimator use actual edge-set lists and failed Covered tests; empty-list real division is explicitly zero. AccurateTrace compares this estimator with the actual finite probability only at states and hosts queried by the tail-first recursion, rather than postulating acceptance behavior.

Congestion two plus 2f+h eligible hosts yields at least h fault-disjoint hosts. Error at most one-eighth and true probability at least one-half force the literal three-eighths threshold, and recursive monotonicity covers every input edge and every admissible original fault set.

The final host wrapper invokes the existing internally constructed doubled Eulerian forest packing and projects actual connected-component trees. Endpoint host counts and original-edge congestion retain the correct direction; no packing or acceptance oracle is introduced.
The final graph equality includes the original seed and every sorted non-seed input edge. The one-vote case and floor((2+eta)f)=2f+floor(eta*f) rounding are exact, with eta>0 unrestricted above.
dependencies_read: BlockerSampling (contracts through imported finite mass and threshold lemmas)
scope: Deterministic good-event implication for literal finite mathematical sampling/voting recursions on finite simple graphs, f>0, t>=1 and globally nonnegative real weights, using an actual connectivity-preserver seed. Classical Covered decisions are noncomputable; this is not an executable shortest-path or paid-machine implementation. The finite tape is assumed accurate on reached states. Independent random generation, adaptive concentration, accepted-output lightness, runtime, weighted multigraph extension and remaining lower-theorem coverage remain open. No whole-paper completion claim. Production gates, exact publication and full CI are separate.
